title: Failed passive-discovery bind leaks its socket
summary: indigo_uni_io.c:1045-1077 and 1094-1116: passive-discovery bind failure logs but does not close udp_socket on either POSIX or Windows. Repeated failed discovery on an occupied/unusable port leaks a socket each attempt. Next: Close socket on every path after successful socket creation. Verify bind-failure cleanup with a controlled occupied local socket in an authorized test.
evidence: indigo_uni_io.c:1045-1077 and 1094-1116: passive-discovery bind failure logs but does not close udp_socket on either POSIX or Windows. Repeated failed discovery on an occupied/unusable port leaks a socket each attempt.
